channel.title: Learn with Ian – Shapes, colors and counting activities for toddlers
channel.description: Shapes, colors and counting activities for toddlers: free printables and free cartoons from Learn with Ian. Ages 2 to 6.

item.title: Free Printable Number Walk Puzzle for Toddlers
item.description: Free printable Number Walk picture puzzle for toddlers and preschoolers, from the Learn with Ian cartoon Ian's Number Walk. Cut the 6 big pieces and build the picture again. Ages 2 to 6. PDF in US Letter and A4.

item.title: Free Shapes Story Sequencing Pictures for Preschoolers
item.description: Free printable Shape Hunt story sequencing cards for preschool and toddlers. Four pictures from the Learn with Ian cartoon Ian's Shape Hunt: cut them out and put the story in order. Ages 2 to 6. PDF in US Letter and A4, with a free video to watch first.
